result:
All changes are in the expected files, both `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` pass, and `bunx guren check` shows no new failures.

**Summary of changes:**
- `app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts`: `excerpt` in `PostPayloadSchema` is now `.optional()` (still trimmed, `min(1)` removed).
- `app/Models/Post.ts`: added `Post.deriveExcerpt(body)`, implementing the 140-char, no-mid-word-cut, ellipsis (`…`) truncation rule.
- `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`: `store` and `update` now compute `data.excerpt || Post.deriveExcerpt(data.body)` and persist that instead of the raw (possibly blank) input, so a blank/whitespace excerpt is always replaced by a derived one — on create and on every update.
- `resources/js/pages/posts/New.tsx` / `Edit.tsx`: label reads "Excerpt (optional)" with a placeholder explaining the fallback; the field no longer needs an initial value to submit.
- `.guren/api-client.gen.ts`: regenerated via `bunx guren codegen` so the generated `body` types mark `excerpt` optional.
- `tests/PostController.test.ts`: added coverage for blank/missing/whitespace excerpt deriving from the body on create, a provided excerpt being trimmed and kept, re-derivation on update from the new body, unchanged title/body validation errors, and unit tests for `Post.deriveExcerpt` covering the mid-word cut and boundary-on-whitespace worked examples plus edge cases (≤140 chars, no whitespace at all, leading/trailing padding).
